_about: The Ranger's own hideout: tenure + decoration + visiting over a #119 interior. Distinct from #99's Syndicate hideout event grammar (beats) and from every care location — a hideout is NEVER a care location: no individual location.kind may read hideout (the value does not exist), and the hideout writes no care axes, bond, honours, or dex state. Zero instances asserted.

hideout.established: #12 fact ref — how/when it became theirs, recorded once
hideout.interiorRef: #119 interior record id (its hostNode is the hideout's one entrance)
hideout.visiting: private | invited | open (per-hideout value is content; default private is a PROPOSAL, not a ruling)

open_register: whether Ranger hideouts exist in canon at all
decor item roster (#31 content — zero instanced)
discovery_rule: the atlas (#137) never reveals a hideout the Ranger has not been given — Leak rule applied socially (per #163's sealing posture)
